title: Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule: Late Application Charges Are Not Refunded
content:
A late application charge on a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit is never refunded when the family cancels. The application charge the permit fee carries, by the day the application was received on the assignment, is taken out of the net fee before the credited share is applied:

| Application received on the assignment | Application charge |
|---|---|
| after the permit period's first school day (August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester permit; January 6, 2027 for a spring semester permit) | 25.00 USD |
| for a school-year or fall semester permit, after July 15, 2026, the first-day application deadline, and on or before August 12, 2026 | 15.00 USD |
| any other application | none |

## Both sides (hypothetical school-year applications)

| Received | Charge |
|---|---|
| July 15, 2026 | none |
| July 16, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 12, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 13, 2026 | 25.00 |

A spring semester application received on January 6, 2027 carries none; one received on January 7, 2027 carries 25.00.

## Example (hypothetical)

A net fee of 95.00 on an application received July 30, 2026 carries a 15.00 charge; 80.00 remains for the credited share to act on.
